original_ai_output.title_zh: 埃塞俄比亚联邦部队重新夺回提格雷首府后，飞往默克莱的航班恢复
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 埃塞俄比亚首都亚的斯亚贝巴与北部提格雷地区首府默克莱之间的航班于周日恢复，此前已停飞超过两周。埃塞俄比亚航空在提格雷人民解放阵线（TPLF）于9月23日夺取该市及机场后暂停了飞往默克莱的航班，并停止了飞往阿克苏姆和希雷的航线。航班恢复是在联邦部队于10月3日重新夺回默克莱、叛军及其领导人放弃该市之后。

location.raw_text: Mekelle, the capital of the northern Tigray region

key_facts.fact: 埃塞俄比亚首都亚的斯亚贝巴与提格雷首府默克莱之间的航班在停飞超过两周后于周日恢复
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Flights between Ethiopia’s capital, Addis Ababa, and Mekelle, the capital of the northern Tigray region, resumed on Sunday after being suspended for more than two weeks.

key_facts.fact: 埃塞俄比亚航空在提格雷人民解放阵线（TPLF）于9月23日夺取该市及机场后暂停了飞往默克莱的航班
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Ethiopian Airlines suspended flights to the capital of the northern Tigray region after the rebel Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF) seized the city and airport on September 23.

key_facts.fact: 联邦部队于10月3日重新夺回默克莱，叛军及其领导人放弃该市
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The restoration of flights comes after federal forces recaptured Mekelle on October 3, with rebel fighters and their leaders abandoning the city.
